entries.not_relevant_because: The manuscript disproves Pietsch's duality conjecture, which compares covering numbers N(K,L) with covering numbers of polar bodies; it never mentions volumes, the volume product vol(K)·vol(K°), the 4ⁿ/n! bound, or the cube and cross-polytope minimisers, so it does not bear on Mahler's volume-product conjecture.
